create_cross_entropy_loss: create a CrossEntropy loss class that flattens logits and targets before computing cross entropy
create_bce_loss: create a BCE loss class that squeezes targets and computes binary cross entropy with logits
create_nlg_loss: create an NLGLoss class that filters out -100 padding tokens before computing cross entropy
create_mse_loss: create an MSE loss class that computes mean squared error between logits and targets
create_smooth_l1_loss: create a SmoothL1 loss class that computes huber loss between logits and targets
